hypothesis.claim: A receipt-bound execution envelope can preserve gamma_safe_mix_v1's Q63 arithmetic and proof populations byte-for-byte while rejecting every dormant plan, occupied managed lane, live qm8 descendant, source drift, and unavailable or substituted toolchain before any proof child output is created.
hypothesis.falsification: Retire this exact envelope if any dormant, occupied, raced, symlinked, process-live, hash-drifted, or toolchain-substituted control reaches a child output; if any accepted child lacks a complete activation receipt; or if the inherited Q63 source, controls, populations, or zero-authority boundary changes.

changedMechanism: Change only SAFE-MIX proof execution authorization and environment binding: a future receipt-bound activation must precede every inherited proof entry point, and canonical lane occupancy is any extant lease or acquisition-lock path rather than an obsolete active boolean inside lease JSON.
invariants: The gamma_safe_mix_v1 Q63 arithmetic source, posterior scope, call order, P/K/D/M arms, negative controls, and five reference populations do not change.
The verified v1 program lock and verification remain immutable inputs rather than files edited by the successor.
Revision 1 remains dormant and cannot execute; a future revision at least 2 binds the exact qm8 terminal receipt and passing independent terminal classification.
Either canonical lease namespace path existing, including a symlink, rejects before any result or scratch root is created.
Any live qm8 owner or descendant rejects even if both namespace paths are absent.
The Python runtime, compiler, linker, activation plan, inherited entry point, arguments, outputs, and schemas are content-addressed before execution.
Every accepted proof phase runs under an external process-tree, cgroup, disk, CPU-affinity, and phase guard in a new disjoint root.
Infrastructure and ideal-regret evidence retain zero archive, inverse, compression, package-score, and objective authority.

controls.definition: Receipt-bound v2 execution envelope over one exact inherited SAFE-MIX v1 proof phase.
The content-addressed v1 entry point whose obsolete active-boolean lease predicate is statically rejected.
Dormant revision-1 activation plan; reject before output.
Canonical managed lease exists; reject without parsing it as free.
Canonical acquisition-lock path exists without a lease; reject without unlinking it.
Lease or acquisition-lock path is a symlink; reject without following or unlinking it.
A qm8 owner or descendant remains live while namespace paths are absent; reject before output.
Program lock, verification, entry point, plan, runtime, compiler, linker, argument, or schema hash differs; reject before child execution.
Declared compiler or linker is absent, non-executable, symlinked, or does not match its activation binding; reject before output.
Two fresh guarded executions from the same activation and child inputs reproduce normalized receipts and child artifacts byte-for-byte.

population.selection: Build A, build B, independent build verification, build-chain controls, transactional controls, native/reference oracle suite, and their activation receipts.
population.coordinate: Ordered activation-plan verification, terminal-evidence binding, process closure, namespace absence, toolchain identity, child command, guarded output, receipt validation, and manifest publication.

measurements.definition: Revision 1 rejects before any child result or scratch output.
Lease, lock, and symlink populations reject without following, modifying, or deleting either path.
Any live qm8 owner or descendant rejects even when namespace paths are absent.
Every source, plan, runtime, compiler, linker, command, and schema equals its content-addressed activation binding.
Accepted v2 child outputs equal the inherited v1 proof semantics and reference populations exactly.
Every child result is paired with a complete independently verifiable activation-chain receipt and output manifest.
Normalized independent activation receipts and child artifacts are byte-identical.
Maximum guarded process-tree RSS across the complete proof envelope.
Maximum guarded cgroup-v2 memory including file cache.
